audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Urgot wins Levels 2-6 while the content whys and the packet chart both say Poppy owns levels 2-3 and Urgot only pulls ahead at 2+ items.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Skill/Skill/Urgot; whys[1] and whys[2] describe level 2-3 as Poppy's window, whys[6] says he out-scales. The rendered chart contradicted its own explanations.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped to the packet ordering, both layers in matched pairs, ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never named Fear Beyond Death or its 100/85/70 cooldown, and the level-6 why did not state the execute threat.
audit.why: Urgot R is an impale plus execute at a health threshold (Riot text) on a 100s cooldown at rank 1 — the concrete reason not to sit low after 6.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why now names Fear Beyond Death and its 100s cooldown; first-item and 2-item rows keyed to Disdain's window and his Cleaver scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Urgot ability was ever named (packet defect confirmed) and the Disdain shield interaction was absent.
audit.why: Disdain (E) shields Urgot as he charges, so bursting into a fresh Disdain feeds the shield and he hurls you into Purge (W) range. Steadfast Presence stops dashes around Poppy and Disdain is a charge, so W is the parry. Purge deals its damage as a channelled unload that also triggers Echoing Flames (P) — the percent-HP grind the old text described anonymously.
audit.corrected: Ability names, Disdain's 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown and the shield-absorbs-burst interaction now stated in tldr, trades, dos and donts.

audit.why: Disdain at 16s rank 1 is the punishable window; Purge's cooldown falls to 0 at rank 5 so it is never the window.
audit.corrected: All engage advice now keyed to the 16s after Disdain is spent.

audit.why: Urgot's Q is flagged 'dash' in the derived data but Riot's description says he fires an explosive charge at a target location — no dash. Not asserted anywhere in the rewrite.

edits.before: His W shreds your HP — E-stun him, dodge his flip. Poppy wins the Disdain cooldown windows.
edits.after: Purge (W) shreds percent HP — E him into a wall, W his Disdain charge. Win the 16s gaps after it.

edits.before: E Urgot into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall while Disdain (16s) is down, Q the zone under him, and W to stop the charge if he does answer.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: E-ing into a fresh Disdain — the shield eats your burst and he hurls you into Purge range.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Urgot's Disdain is down.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops Disdain mid-charge — hold W as a parry, then E-stun him while his 16s E is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Urgot must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online: E him into a wall, Q the zone under him, W out before Purge ramps. Keep the wave near your side so he walks in.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: It evens out: Purge's percent-HP answers your chunk, so trade only in the 16s after Disdain and bank small leads, never long fights.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict punts him away, but Fear Beyond Death (100s) executes you low — never dip under his threshold near him. Even level.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights in the 16s window after he spends Disdain.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-scales: Cleaver and tank items make Purge's percent-HP beat your flat damage — play frontline and peel, don't side-lane duel.

edits.before: His engage. E-stun after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s at rank 1. Bait it, then E-stun inside that window.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Purge is percent-HP: W for the move speed and walk out, never stand.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain hurls you into his legs — hold W to stop the charge outright.

notes: Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) carries a 'dash' derived flag that contradicts Riot's own text (a charge fired at a target location); not asserted anywhere. Level chart in both layers disagreed with packet.levelChart and with the content whys — flipped as one atomic group, side+win paired, ratings included.
